after_hours_reply.en:
Thank you for reaching out. Our customer service team is  
currently unavailable as it's outside of our operating hours 
Mon–Fri: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM 
Sat–Sun & Public Holidays: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM 
To learn more about our product and services, you may visit our website at emas.proton.com or social media, at PROTON e.MAS Cars. We will respond to your inquiry as soon as we resume operations. Thank you for your patience.

email_auto_acknowledgement._note: Sent by the agent service's EMAIL_AUTOACK_ENABLED path, not by a Chatwoot inbox setting. Included here so both customer-facing texts have one verifiable source.
email_auto_acknowledgement.en:
Dear Customer,
Thank you for your email. This message serves to acknowledge receipt of your enquiry.
We will respond within one (1) business day during our operating hours.
For urgent matters, please contact our Call Centre at 1300 888 877.
Operating Hours:
Monday–Friday: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
Saturday, Sunday & Public Holidays: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Warm regards,
Proton e.MAS Centre

operating_hours._note: Stated in Appendix B alongside the reply text. Mirror these into each inbox's Chatwoot working-hours config, or the working-hours SLA clock measures against the wrong calendar.
